chunks: take a grip on your affairs and acquire your (lot and your) share.
If you do not like it then go away to where neither you are welcome nor can you escape from it.
It is better that you be left alone and lie sleeping.
Then no one will enquire where so-and-so is.

key_terms.رَحْبٍ: spaciousness/welcome (here implying a place of honor or acceptance)

ai.seo_question: What advice did Imam Ali give to Abu Musa regarding his governorship and self-restraint?
ai.summary: In this letter, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) advises Abu Musa al-Ash'ari to exercise self-control and accept his share of authority or duty. If he dislikes his position, he should withdraw quietly to avoid further scrutiny or conflict, effectively removing himself from the scene so that people cease to ask about his whereabouts or status.
